style: Driving instrumental electronic space battle game soundtrack, inspired by FTL and FTL Multiverse. A firm syncopated electronic drum groove, active deep synth bass, crisp snare and hi-hats, small tom fills and layered answering arpeggios. Urgent, tense and focused. Precise clockwork synth plucks, an expressive wistful electronic lead, restless melodic bass and warm slowly opening pads; determined momentum with a bittersweet release. Build the full rhythmic arrangement through the first theme, thin it in the middle while keeping the pulse audible, then return with richer counterpoint and stronger drums. A tactical space battle. Purely instrumental. Bm, 126 BPM.
